description: Paid (1.00 USDC per page); free alternatives: get_track_record for the totals. For "how did your picks do last weekend?" in the Premier League, Championship, League 1 or League 2. Settled tactica. picks, 20 per page, newest first: match, kick-off, league, selection, market, tier, outcome and score; no odds or per-pick profit. Use this when you need pick-by-pick detail or "how did last weekend go": period (last-weekend, last-midweek, last-7-days) or dateFrom/dateTo (UK) narrow it and add an outcome summary. Use get_track_record instead (free) for totals by market, league and tier. Read-only; every pick settled to date, with an observedAt time. A page past the end gives the page count.

dateFrom.description: Optional. First UK kick-off date, YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2026-11-20

dateTo.description: Optional. Last UK kick-off date, YYYY-MM-DD. Example: 2026-11-23

page.description: Optional, default 1. Page number, an integer from 1; 20 settled picks per page, and every reply gives the total number of pages. Example: 2

period.description: Optional. last-weekend (Friday to Monday, UK), last-midweek (Tuesday to Thursday) or last-7-days: only picks that kicked off then, same price. Example: last-weekend

name: get_settled_record
title: Get settled picks
